items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: Abel and Baker were the two monkeys. They set up in a rocket.

ctx.x: The only other thing. I found with you. Was. Maybe when you want to forget. I don't know. Abel and Baker. Gene and Al. With the space monks. Do you know who Abel and Baker were? No. I don't.
Abel and Baker were the two monkeys. They set up in a rocket.
